title: Helsefagarbeider søkes på natt som BPA-assistent
description:
Jeg er en mann på 24 år som søker etter Helsefagarbeider som BPA-assistent på natt, der du kan bli en del av hverdagen min.

Jeg er veldig glad i musikk, gaming, motorsport, og generelt alt som har med fart og spenning å gjøre. Jeg liker å komme meg ut og finne på ting, enten det er kino, utflukter, eller andre aktiviteter. Samtidig består selvfølgelig livet også av helt vanlige hverdager hjemme.

Jeg har også en stor hund som er en del av hverdagen min. Det er derfor viktig at du er komfortabel med hund og ikke er allergisk.

Som BPA-assistent skal du hjelpe meg med de tingene jeg ikke kan gjøre selv, slik at jeg kan leve livet mitt slik jeg ønsker.


Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

• Personlig stell og praktisk bistand

• Matlaging

• Husarbeid og andre praktiske oppgaver

• Bistand hjemme og ute

• Kjøre bil og bli med på ulike aktiviteter og utflukter

• Bli med på blant annet kino, arrangementer og andre ting jeg finner på

• Andre oppgaver som naturlig hører til i hverdagen

• På natt er det hovedsakelig oppgaver som snuing og tilsyn


Jeg ser etter deg som er pålitelig, rolig og ansvarsfull, men som samtidig ikke er redd for å bli med når det skjer litt. Det er viktig for meg at vi kommer godt overens, siden man som BPA-assistent jobber tett sammen med meg og blir en del av hverdagen min.

Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å dele alle interessene mine, men det er selvfølgelig et pluss dersom du liker noe av det samme og synes det høres hyggelig ut å bli med på forskjellige aktiviteter.

 

Stilling og arbeidstider:

Jeg ser etter en Helsefagarbeider som kan jobbe fast på natt i en 59% stilling, med hver tredje helg.

Arbeidstider er 23:00 – 08:00 alle dager.

Oppstart er 01.11.26, eller etter avtale.


Krav til deg:

• Førerkort klasse B

• Du må kunne kommunisere godt på norsk

• Du må være pålitelig og møte opp til avtalte vakter

• Du må være komfortabel med hund og ikke være allergisk


Ingen dager er nødvendigvis helt like. Noen vakter kan være rolige dager hjemme med gaming, musikk og vanlige gjøremål, mens andre kan innebære en dagstur eller et arrangement med litt mer fart og spenning.

Høres dette ut som en jobb som kunne passet deg? Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad og forteller litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe som BPA-assistent og gjerne litt om hva du liker å gjøre på fritiden.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

title: Vil du bruke fagkompetansen din i ein meiningsfull BPA-jobb?
description:
Eg er ein livsglad mann på 29 år, som bur i eige tilrettelagt hus. Eg likar godt å ta ein sykkeltur på tandem sykkelen min, ein liten gåtur på veg og i terreng, og bruker rullestol ved lengre turer, og ride tur ein gong i veka. Assistentanelegg til rette for ulike aktiviteter, som eg har glede og nytte av. Og hjelp til hushold. Eg kommuniserer med kroppsspråk og supplerende alternativ kommunikasjon.

Hos meg vil du få en meiningsfull jobb.

Som assistent blir du ein viktig del av eit lite og engasjert team. Du får ein variert arbeidskvardag, der du får bruke både fagkompetansen og dei personlege eigenskapane dine.

Du vil få god opplæring og tett samarbeid med resten av teamet.

Vi kan tilby:

  • Ei meiningsfull og variert arbeidshverdag
  • Moglegheit til å bruke og utvikle fagkompetansen din
  • God opplæring og oppfølging
  • Eit trygt og inkluderande arbeidsmiljø
  • Tett samarbeid med eit engasjert team
  • Rullerande Nordsjøturnus, som gir lengre samanhengande friperiodar

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har pedagogisk eller helsefagleg høgskuleutdanning, eller anna relevant bakgrunn
  • Likar å kommunisere og samhandle med menneske som nyttar alternativ og supplerande kommunikasjon (ASK)
  • Er trygg, tolmodig og omsorgsfull
  • Kan arbeide sjølvstendig og samtidig vere ein god lagspelar
  • Er fleksibel og ser moglegheiter i kvardagen

Krav i stillingen:

  • Plettfri vandel/politiattest
  • Gode norskkunnskaper
  • Førerkort

Emosjonelle krav:

I jobben som personlig assistent i JAG stilles det emosjonelle krav. Emosjonelle krav handler om de følelsesmessige kravene som stilles til arbeidstaker i møte med andre. Håndtering av egne og andres følelser er en viktig del av jobben. I rollen som personlig assistent kan man komme i situasjoner hvor man må justere og/eller beherske egne følelser, samt håndtere andre menneskers følelser inkludert sorger og gleder. Det vil være ulike krav i de ulike BPA-ordningene, dette gås gjennom på intervju og ved praktisk opplæring på arbeidsplassen.

Som personlig assistent i JAG utgjør du en forskjell hver dag, og personlig egnethet er avgjørende.

Lønn:

JAG Assistanse følger Tariffavtale (Landsoverenskomsten for BPA). Lønnsplassering ut fra dokumentert ansiennitet ved ansettelse. Relevant erfaring kan være BPA-assistent, barne- og ungdomsarbeider, førskolelærer, helsefagarbeider mm. Det må tilsvarer minimum 50% stilling.

JAG Assistanse AS (JAG) er en ideell leverandør av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) og styrer etter non-profitt prinsippet. JAG har bred kompetanse på organisering av BPA-tjenester, spesielt for personer med sammensatte funksjonsnedsettelser, hvorav en kan være av kognitiv art. Vi arbeider for at alle uavhengig av funksjonsnedsettelse skal kunne leve sine liv fullt ut på egne vilkår, og skreddersyr hver enkelt BPA-ordning.

title: Vil du bli en del av mitt BPA team?
description:
Jeg er på utkikk etter en hyggelig assistent til et trygt og langvarig vikariat med oppstart snarest og varighet ut mai 2027. Hos meg vil du få en variert og meningsfull jobbhverdag i trivelige omgivelser i Heggedal.

Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er en imøtekommende og samfunnsengasjert mann med en god porsjon humor. Jeg sitter i rullestol, bor alene og er en aktiv person som trives med sykling, reiser og sosiale aktiviteter. Datteren min på 10 år er ofte på besøk, så det er helt avgjørende at du trives sammen med barn.

Jeg er selvstendig og ønsker å styre hverdagen min selv. Din rolle blir å være mine "armer og bein" der det trengs. Du må ha god situasjonsforståelse og vite når du skal bistå aktivt, og når du skal holde deg i bakgrunnen

Hvem er du?

Jeg ser etter deg som er pliktoppfyllende, tålmodig og glad i en god samtale. Du bør være praktisk anlagt og trives med varierte oppgaver. Siden vi skal jobbe tett sammen, er det viktig at kjemien stemmer og at du har en positiv innstilling og godt humør!

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Assistanse ved matlaging, handling og generelt husarbeid.

  • Praktisk bistand i forbindelse med oppfølging av min datter (10 år).

  • Personlig stell og assistanse ved forflytning (inn/ut av stol).

  • Praktisk arbeid i hagen og vedlikehold.

  • Bilkjøring til aktiviteter, turer og ærender.

  • Ledsagelse og assistanse ved sosiale arrangementer og eventuelle reiser.

Arbeidssted, arbeidstid og omfang

Arbeidet foregår i mitt hjem i Heggedal sentrum (gode kollektivforbindelser og god parkering).

  • Stillingstype: Vikariat fra september til mai 2027. Gode muligheter for videre samarbeid eller fast stilling som tilkallingsvikar etter perioden.

  • Arbeidstid: Fast annen hver helg samt tilkallingsvakter. Det kan også bli aktuelt med bistand ved reiser.

Kvalifikasjoner (Krav)

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, minimum nivå B1 (grunnet behov for kommunikasjon).

  • Du må være over 18 år.

  • Plettfri politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse.

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS og MOVA

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

title: Støttekontakt
description:
Oppdrag som støttekontakt for personer med rusvansker. 


Bergen Kommune har er et byomfattende tiltak som blant annet gir individuell oppfølging til personer med utfordringer knyttet til rus.
I tillegg har tjenesten ansvar for å rekruttere støttekontakter til personer med rusvansker.
Tjenesten har nå et økende behov for personer som kan ta oppdrag som støttekontakter for disse tjenestemottakerne.
Mennesker med rusproblemer som trenger støttekontakt har ofte stor grad av sosial angst. På grunn av lite sosialt nettverk utenfor rusmiljøet trenger de gjerne en person som kan være med på sosiale aktiviteter som trening, tur, musikk, klatring, kafebesøk eller lignende. Ofte trenger de bare en person å prate med.

 

For nærmere opplysninger om støttekontakt se Bergen kommunes nettsider, eventuelt ta kontakt med Therese Berntsen 94 50 50 80.


KvalifikasjonerFor å bli støttekontakt bør du være fylt 23 år og du må ha språkkompetanse B2. Du må være pålitelig og trygg på deg selv. Det stilles ingen formelle krav til utdanning, men det kan være en fordel med erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker.
Støttekontakten må ha overskudd å gi av, være trygg på seg selv og ha evnen til samarbeid. Støttekontakten må kunne holde avtaler, sette grenser og forholde seg profesjonelt til rollen sin. Støttekontakt må være en god rollemodell og overholde regler og lover.
Oppdragene strekker seg mellom 1 til 5 timer i uken. Godtgjørelse pr timer er kr 186-.
Som støttekontakt blir du pålagt å fremvise politiattest. Det kreves politiattest for personer som skal yte helse- og omsorgstjenester.Personlige egenskaperVi søker deg som er engasjert i brukergruppen, selvstendig, initiativrik, fleksibel og pålitelig. Vi tilbyrJevnlig veiledning på telefon og fysiske møter, samt gruppeveiledning med andre støttekontakter inntil to ganger pr. årKontaktinformasjonTherese Lund Berntsen, avdelingsleder

title: Helsefagarbeider/hjelpepleier
description:
Ønskjer du ein variert og spennande arbeidskvardag?
Heimetenesta har for tida ledige stillingar som helsefagarbeidar.

I heimetenesta jobbar ein både ute på bygda i private bustader og inne i omsorgsbustader.
Heimetenesta i Midt-Telemark er organisert i tre soner: Sone Bø, Sone Gvarv og Fagsona. I Fagsona har me fleire team som arbeider målretta med prinsippet «kva er viktig for deg» innan ulike fagområde som demens, sårbehandling, kreftomsorg, innsatsteam og sjukepleiarprosedyrar. Innsatsteamet gir tett oppfølging til pasientar som i periodar treng ekstra støtte for å meistre kvardagen på eiga hand. Sjølv om me er delt inn i soner, er me éi samla avdeling som samarbeider tett.

I tillegg til eit godt fagleg og sosialt arbeidsmiljø, kan me skryte av høg takhøgd for ulike meiningar og mykje humor i kvardagen. Me kastar oss ut i alle prosjekt som kan bidra til å gjere oss til den beste heimetenesta – både for tilsette og pasientar. Avdelinga har årsturnus, og du får høve til å påverke eigen arbeidsplan i stor grad.
Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Helsetenester og oppfylging av pasientar  
  • Samarbeid med pårørande 
  • Samarbeid med andre aktørar som lege, ergoterapeut, fysioterapeut og tenestekontor 
  • Dokumentasjon 
Kvalifikasjonar

Krav til kvalifikasjonar

  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeidar/hjelpepleier eller mål om å utdanne seg til helsefagarbeider.
  • Du må kunne kommunisere godt på norsk, både skriftleg og munnleg, minimum B1 nivå
  • Førerkort klasse B 

Ønska kompetanse

  •  Erfaring frå helseteneste 
  • God kjennskap til bruk av data som verktøy, jf. dokumentasjonsplikt

Særskilde krav

  • Krav om politiattest, jf. Lov om Helse og omsorgstjenester § 5-4. Politiattest skal framvisast før oppstart i stilling.
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Har evne til sjølvstendig, strukturert og målretta arbeid 
  • Har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner 
  • Er strukturerte og løysningsorientera 
  • Du må ha godt humør og inneha ein positiv innstilling, samt tolmodige til å kunne tole psykiske og fysiske krevjande utfordringar
  • Evne til å ivareta og bidra til eit god arbeidsmiljø 

Personlege eigenskapar vektlegast.

Vi tilbyr

Me ønskjer i møte med innbyggjarane våre å fremja sjølvstende, kvardagsmeistring, tryggleik og oppleving av styring og kontroll i eige liv. Tenestene me yter skal bidra til å støtta opp under ressursane i personen og samtidig byggja opp under ansvaret til den enkelte og aktiv medverknad i eige liv. Me jobbar ut i frå «kva er viktig for deg?» metodikken og legg til rette for at pårørande, familie og nettverk medverkar i samsvar med ønska til den enkelte. title: Avdelingsleder
description:
Flyktningtjenesten søker etter ny avdelingsleder. Stillingen er organisert som en del av virksomheten mestring, helse og aktivitet. 

Tjenesten består per i dag av 14 ansatte fordelt på to team: bosettingsteamet og introduksjonsprogramteamet. Vi har et tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø med medarbeidere med ulik fagbakgrunn, både høyskoleutdannede og fagarbeidere.

Bosettingsteamet har ansvar for bosetting og oppfølging av nyankomne flyktninger etter anmodning fra IMDi. Arbeidet omfatter blant annet tilrettelegging for oppstart i barnehage og skole, veiledning om fritidsaktiviteter og praktisk bistand i etableringsfasen. Teamet samarbeider tett med introduksjonsprogramteamet om planlegging og gjennomføring av tiltak som fremmer integrering og deltakelse.

Introduksjonsprogramteamet følger opp deltakere i introduksjonsprogrammet og har ansvar for saksbehandling, vedtaksfatting, utarbeidelse av integreringsplaner og annen dokumentasjon i henhold til integreringsloven. Teamet planlegger og gjennomfører også tiltak som støtter deltakernes kvalifisering til arbeid og utdanning.

Flyktningtjenesten har et omfattende samarbeid med blant annet NAV, Karmøy Voksenopplæringssenter, andre kommunale tjenester, lokalt næringsliv og frivillige lag og organisasjoner. 

Avdelingen er sårbar for omstilling med tanke på at inntak av flyktninger kan variere fra år til år. Avdelingsleder må være trygg på å lede en avdeling i omstilling og være forberedt på å bistå med driftsoppgaver ved behov. 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for dialog med IMDI
  • Ansvar for koordinering av IMDIs tilskuddsordning
  • Ansvar for fagprogram visma flyktning
  • Ansvar for å holde seg oppdatert på lov- og forskriftsendringer 
  • Utvikling-, fag og personalansvar
  • Resultatansvar for mål og prioriteringer
  • Lede interne endrings- og utviklingsprosesser
  • Lede HMS og arbeidsmiljøarbeid, det vil si hvordan arbeidet organiseres, planlegges og gjennomføres
  • Knytte kontakt og opprettholde gode samarbeidsrelasjoner til interne og eksterne aktører
  • Rapportering
  • Ansvar for økonomi i egen avdeling
  • Ansvar for å skrive politiske saker knyttet til inntak av flyktninger 
  • Kommunen er stadig i endring, derfor kan andre oppgaver også tilfalle avdelingsleder i samråd med virksomhetsleder
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant høgskole/universitetsutdanning
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra arbeid med integrering og flyktninger 
  • Ønskelig med ledererfaring
  • Ønskelig med videreutdanning innen ledelse, men ikke ett krav
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli sterkt vektlagt
  • Førerkort kl B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Evne til å jobbe målrettet, effektivt og resultatorientert
  • Pågangsmot og utholdenhet
  • Initiativ og evne til å påvirke
  • Evne til å skape gode relasjoner
  • Evne til å jobbe selvstendig og strukturert
  • Evne til å håndtere endring og skiftende rammebetingelser
Vi tilbyr
  • Spennende lederoppgaver 
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Er strukturert og pålitelig --- du holder oversikt, følger rutiner og sørger for at ting blir gjort riktig første gang.

  • Jobber selvstendig --- du tar initiativ, løser små utfordringer på egen hånd og trives med ansvar.

  • Trives med variert arbeid --- ingen dag er lik, og du liker kombinasjonen av gjestekontakt, systemarbeid og praktiske oppgaver.

  • Har god serviceinnstilling --- du møter gjester med varme, ro og profesjonalitet, også når det er travelt.

  • Kommuniserer godt --- både muntlig og skriftlig, med evne til å formidle informasjon tydelig.

  • Har goda datakunnskaper --- erfaring med hotellsystemer er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

  • Behersker norsk og engelsk --- du kan hjelpe gjester fra både inn- og utland.

  • Har øye for detaljer og sikkerhet --- du legger merke til små ting som gjør gjesteopplevelsen bedre og driften tryggere.

  • Er fleksibel på arbeidstid --- du kan jobbe dag, kveld og helg etter behov.

  • Har fylt 25 år --- grunnet ansvar og rutiner knyttet til hotelldrift.

  • Har gjerne erfaring fra hotell eller resepsjon --- men det er ikke et krav. Vi gir god opplæring.

Arbeidsoppgaver Resepsjon -- Hotel Kong Carl

Hotel Kong Carl søker en ansvarsbevisst og serviceinnstilt resepsjonist til vårt historiske hotell i hjertet av Sandefjord. Resepsjonen er hotellets samlingspunkt, og du vil være en viktig del av gjestenes første møte med oss.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som resepsjonist vil du blant annet ha ansvar for:

  • Innsjekk og gjesteoppfølging --- ta imot ankomster, gi informasjon og sikre en god start på oppholdet.

  • Bookinghåndtering --- registrere og oppdatere bookinger, avreiser og romstatus i hotellsystemet Opera Cloud.

  • Sikkerhetsrapporter --- utskrift og håndtering av daglige rapporter (in‑house og ankomster).

  • Utsjekk --- avslutte opphold, håndtere betalinger og sikre en smidig avreise.

  • Kurs- og møterom --- klargjøring, koordinering og enkel teknisk støtte ved behov.

  • Telefon og e‑post --- besvare henvendelser og gi god informasjon til gjester og samarbeidspartnere.

  • Generell gjesteservice --- bidra til et hyggelig og profesjonelt miljø i resepsjonen og hotellet.


Vi tilbyr Vi tilbyr

  • En selvstendig og ansvarsfull stilling

  • Et hyggelig og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø

  • Arbeid i et historisk hotell med stolte tradisjoner

  • Gode kollegaer og varierte arbeidsdager

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hotel Kong Carl er et historisk og tradisjonsrikt hotell midt i hjertet av Sandefjord. Hotellet kombinerer klassisk eleganse med personlig service og har lange tradisjoner for å ta godt imot både forretningsreisende og fritidsgjester.

Med restaurant, kurs- og konferansefasiliteter og et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø, er Hotel Kong Carl en arbeidsplass hvor kvalitet, samarbeid og gjestetilfredshet står i fokus.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

administracja platformą wirtualizacyjną VMware vSphere;
administracja systemami Windows Server (instalacja, konfiguracja, aktualizacje);
zarządzanie usługą domenową Active Directory; zarządzanie kontami, uprawnieniami oraz wdrażanie polityk bezpieczeństwa;

współpraca z zespołami developerskimi, sieciowymi, bezpieczeństwa, przy wdrożeniach i zmianach;
tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej oraz procedur operacyjnych.

znajomość zagadnień związanych z normami i regulacjami bezpieczeństwa informacji (ISO 27001, NIS2, RODO  aspekt praktyczny w IT);
znajomość technologii firmy Fortinet (w szczególności FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail);
wiedza z zakresu sieci komputerowych (TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, VPN, podstawowe mechanizmy bezpieczeństwa sieciowego);
doświadczenie w pracy z systemami monitoringu (preferowany Zabbix);

description:
Project Manager / Delivery Assurance for SAP and Service Now (f/m/d)

Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.

We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow

**Location: **Germany, Poland, Bulgaria or Romania

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.

Do you love challenges?

As Project / Delivery Assurance Manager for SAP and ServiceNow Projects and Managed Services, you will be responsible for:

■ Conducting risk and quality assessments for new and existing large customer engagements, ensuring SAP and ServiceNow-specific risks are addressed.

■ Providing feedback on the Deal Governance process to ensure that new projects and services meet agreed standards and quality expectations.

■ Supporting Red/Amber projects by developing and executing "Back to Green" action plans, including internal management reporting.

■ Managing customer escalations: leading top management customer escalations, supporting executive management in the de-escalation process, addressing root causes, and restoring customer confidence.

■ Defining the necessary quality checks for SAP and ServiceNow projects and services to ensure quality, speed and profitability

Convince us with your potential!

■ Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

Several years of work experience in Delivery Assurance, Project and/or Services Management proves your:

■ Expertise in SAP and ServiceNow within complex enterprise environments

■ Delivery assurance skills, supported by certification (e.g. Six Sigma)

■ Strong project/service management and leadership abilities

■ Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach

■ Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders

■ Commitment to continuous improvement, attention to detail, and adaptability under pressure

■ Knowledge of IT standards and regulations (ISO 9001, CMMI, GDPR)

■ Proficiency in written and spoken English and German

Do you have questions?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents stating your earliest start date.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
To Change What's Possible For Everyone

SENIOR NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (M/F/D)

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

DP World, one of the world's leading logistics providers, is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) to join our European Network team in Lódz.

In this role, you will take ownership of our network security landscape across Europe, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous improvement of critical network infrastructure. You will act as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, work closely with Information Security and global IT teams, and support projects across multiple European locations. Please note that regular travel within Europe and occasional out-of-hours work are required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.
* Administer and enhance the Forescout NAC and network segmentation platform.
* Design, implement, and support secure LAN, WAN, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Firewall solutions.
* Manage Check Point and Palo Alto firewalls, IPS technologies, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on threat detection, investigations, and security improvements.
* Support network projects end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational support.

YOUR PROFILE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise network installation, configuration, and support.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Forescout or similar NAC/segmentation technologies.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and enterprise networking.
* Proven experience with Check Point and Palo Alto firewall technologies.
* Fluent English (at least C1), strong troubleshooting skills, and willingness to travel across Europe.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Permanent employment with a global and growing logistics leader
* Salary: PLN 91,663 – 145,800 gross per year*
* Private medical care (LUX MED)
* Group life insurance
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) supporting employees and their families
* Employment contract in an international logistics company

The final salary level will depend on the candidate's professional experience, skills, and qualifications.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

PMO Lead (Gestor de Projetos de TIC)

A Buzzvel é uma empresa de desenvolvimento de software com mais de 100 produtos digitais entregues em saúde, SaaS, retalho, hotelaria e governance. Procuramos um PMO Lead para estabelecer, orientar e melhorar continuamente a gestão de projetos.

Missão: assegurar o alinhamento dos projetos internos e de clientes com a estratégia da empresa, supervisionar o portefólio de iniciativas e otimizar a alocação de recursos em múltiplos projetos. Trabalha na dependência direta do CEO, com autonomia e participação ativa nas decisões estratégicas.

Responsabilidades:
- Liderar a equipa do PMO e desenvolver as competências de gestão de projetos, incluindo os Gestores de Clientes
- Alinhar a estratégia do PMO com os objetivos da organização e supervisionar a gestão do portefólio
- Estabelecer estruturas de governação e metodologias de gestão de projetos
- Impulsionar a otimização de recursos e o planeamento de capacidade
- Gerir relações com stakeholders ao nível executivo e implementar estratégias de gestão de risco
- Desenvolver métricas de desempenho e sistemas de reporting
- Promover a melhoria contínua e assegurar padrões de qualidade em todos os projetos
- Preparar relatórios, business cases e recomendações para a gestão de topo
- Acompanhar e gerir clientes, em particular os clientes estratégicos

Perfil pretendido:
- Licenciatura e mínimo de 5 anos em gestão de projetos ou programas, com liderança de equipas
- Metodologias de gestão de projetos, conceção e otimização de processos, gestão financeira e orçamentação
- Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos e de análise de dados
- Inglês fluente, escrito e falado
- Pensamento estratégico, atenção ao detalhe, negociação e comunicação superior

A Buzzvel adota o conceito de função ampla: nenhuma função é exercida de modo exclusivo e permanente, o que permite desenvolver novas competências e valências.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: Cuisinier (H/F)
description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.

•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Po riadnom zaškolení sa samostatne staráte o prípravu raňajok, čo vám dáva možnosť ukázať svoje zručnosti. V prípade potreby a po zaučení zastupujete šéfkuchára. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.
Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Uži si prácu v úspešnej reštaurácii, ktorá je známa svojou kvalitou a štýlovým prostredím. Ak máš záujem, pošli svoj životopis alebo nás kontaktuj osobne v Hoteli GOLFER , Kremnica. Tešíme sa na nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorý á bude s nami tvoriť príjemnú atmosféru pre našich hostí aj celý tím!

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v oblasti informačných a komunikačných technológií
description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

title: Account Manager Executive (German - speaking) -  Remote work in Spain - HE04 (Account-Manager/in)
description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.
- Lead the solution-building process and engage pooled central inside sales specialists and presales experts when needed.
- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.
- Have 1–3 years of relevant industry sales experience.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**  

- Full-time, permanent contract, 39 hours/week: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00
- Base salary of 20,976 euros gross/year + up to 7,400 euros gross/year in bonus + private medical insurance
- Location at either our Barcelona, Malaga or Valencia office, or remote from Spain, if you are not based at one of these locations (except Canary Islands)
- Full paid training about the company and the project you will be working on
- Career development program and specialized courses

**Experience the best version of you!**  

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.  

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”
