Notre savoir est à la hauteur des défis actuels et nous le transmettons à ceux et celles qui étudient à la \[BFH\](\< \>) ou qui s'y perfectionnent en cours d'emploi. Nous avons de grands projets d'avenir. Nous unissons nos forces pour contribuer efficacement à l'épanouissement d'une société durable, soucieuse de sa santé et qui se distingue par sa maturité numérique. Nous créons ainsi des perspectives idéales pour favoriser votre action au sein de notre école. \*\*Je vous accompagne durant le processus de candidature\*\* Danielle Bachmann conseillère RH T Pour vos questions concernant le poste Abdallah Alaoui Project Manager T jpidd9ed451jm jpit0939jm jpiy26jm

title: Chief Executive Officer at Theseus Robotics Group
description:
Chief Executive Officer at Theseus Robotics Group
Company: Theseus Robotics Group AG
Location: Opfikon-Glattbrugg / Zürich, Switzerland
Workload: Full-time (100%), on-site in Zürich
About Theseus Robotics
Theseus Robotics Group AG is a Zürich-based ETH spin-off building autonomous dual-arm robots that restock supermarket shelves overnight, offered to retailers as Robotics-as-a-Service.
Role purpose
The CEO leads the company and is accountable to the Board for turning the business plan into funded, revenue-generating deployments with retailers in Switzerland and abroad.
Key responsibilities
Strategy and financing: set and execute the strategy and business plan; lead fundraising, investor relations and financial planning; report to the Board on performance.
Commercial development: own relationships with retail and logistics customers and partners; take them from demos and pilots to paid deployments; set pricing and go-to-market strategy.
Operations and supply chain: oversee hardware suppliers, manufacturing partners and robot deployment operations in Europe and abroad.
Legal and compliance: oversee contracts, employment, insurance and regulatory matters with external counsel, and make sure the company is ready for each deployment.
Organisation: build and lead the team within the approved budget, set company goals and reporting routines, and align the executive team on priorities.
External representation: represent the company to customers, investors, suppliers, authorities and the public, with travel in Switzerland and abroad.
Required profile
Bachelor's degree (required) in computer science, engineering or a related technical field; a management or business qualification is an advantage.
Fluent English (required); German is an advantage.
At least 3 years in a founder, CEO or managing director role with full P&L responsibility.
Proven record of growing revenue in a technology-driven business, including B2B sales, commercial negotiations and strategic partnerships.
Experience leading hardware, electronics or mechatronics product development, including R&D teams and manufacturing or production facilities.
Experience building and managing international supply chains and supplier networks across Europe, Asia and North America.
Strong background in software, machine learning or data science, enough to lead a robotics/AI company and work credibly with engineers.
Track record in fundraising, investor relations and financial planning.
Experience leading teams of 20+ people across several functions.
Willing to work full-time in person from the Zürich office and travel often.

title: Terms of Reference Investment Specialist
description:
Terms of Reference
Investment Specialist (80% or full-time)

Catalytic’s mission is to accelerate the design and deployment of catalytic finance solutions for sustainable infrastructure and nature. We identify and develop robust project pipelines and deploy technical assistance to support projects to become more investible and impactful. Catalytic seeks to ensure positive social and environmental outcomes in addition to financial returns for impact investors, applying credible methodologies for the measurement and evaluation of impacts. In addition, Catalytic incubates and structures blended-finance funds aiming at scaling up and speeding up the implementation of infrastructure projects with positive climate impacts.

Catalytic is seeking an Investment Specialist.
Catalytic has also been mandated through Canopy Trust by multiple donors to support and scale up private sector, development-focused investments to reduce deforestation in Central Africa, covering DRC, Republic of the Congo, Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Gabon. To this end, Canopy Trust identifies and builds a robust pipeline of investment funds and local, private sector projects and companies which will lead to  economic development, reduction of deforestation, and conservation of forest in the region. Canopy Trust offers technical assistance and invests catalytic, concessional capital to direct investment, it also investor de-risking junior capital into suitable investment funds that commit to capital allocation to Canopy Trust’s target countries.. The Investment Specialist will primarily work on the investment activities for Canopy Trust.

Reporting to the Deputy CEO and working closely with other team members and Catalytic’s partners, the Investment Specialist will support Catalytic in deploying its concessional capital. This will include originating investment opportunities, conducting evaluation, assessment and due diligence of investment opportunities (investment funds, corporates/SMEs and projects), as well as the negotiation of term sheets, preparation of documentations for the Investment Committees, and finalisation of investment documentations until financial close. The Investment Specialist will also be responsible for managing Canopy Trust’s portfolio of investments, including advising, supporting, and monitoring the investees in the portfolio as well as reporting.

Role & Responsibilities:
Independently lead identification sourcing and management high-quality transaction pipeline in line with Canopy Trust’s mandate, target sectors and geographies through direct outreach and relevant channels in the target region, manage selection workflow and maintain pipeline tracker
Maintain close proximity and awareness with the Canopy Trust Technical Assistance pipeline to be able to assess which of these TA projects to prioritize for investment pipeline and to anticipate the associated timeline
Independently lead investment processes, including screening of investment opportunities and preparing documentation for internal decision-making and prioritization
Independently lead and coordinate due diligence (financial, operational, legal, integrity and ESG), (credit) risk analysis, term sheet negotiation (structuring features, conditions precedent, covenants, reporting and monitoring requirements)
Lead preparation of high-quality investment memorandums and recommendations for submission to the IC, and investment documentation.
Advise, support, and monitor the investees
Manage Canopy Trust’s investment portfolio including post investment activities and analysis
Provide numbers, results, and deliverables for Communication, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting.
Support in other investment-related activities of Catalytic when required.

Profile:
Minimum 5 years of experience in investment analysis, due diligence, negotiation of term sheets and contracts, structuring and closing transactions, overseeing investees, and portfolio management, preferably at an asset manager, investment bank or financial advisor.
Experience in working in an investment role in Africa and/or other frontier and emerging markets and fragile country contexts, preferably in Canopy Trust’s focus markets
Working experience in direct private debt investments and structuring; experience in restructuring and workouts preferred.
Experience in Canopy Trust’s focus sectors and a good understanding of business development and financial models of infrastructure projects, experience in deforestation-free value chain investment
Experience working in the space of impact, blended-finance investment for climate targets would be a plus.
Experience in managing or investing in and/or managing investment funds, including understanding of blended finance structures and risk mitigation instruments, concessionality and GP diligence would be a plus.
Experience with international standards, such as IFC Performance Standards, Gold Standard, would be a plus.
Passionate about reducing deforestation and climate mitigation with a strong commitment towards a more sustainable world.
Team player, flexible and experienced in working in a multicultural environment.
Taking initiatives and thinking out of the box to find solutions to challenges are needed on a daily basis.
Proficient English and French level in writing and speaking, additional language skills a plus.
Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in business, finance or economics.

The working station will be Geneva, Switzerland, or Kinshasa, DRC, with travels depending on project needs.

The position is possible to start at 80%. However, as the investment portfolio enlarges, it is expected that 100% would be needed at some point in the future.

Please send your CV and a Cover Letter to secretariat@catalyticfinance.org by 31 October 2026. Please indicate clearly on your Cover Letter your intended working station (Geneva or Kinshasa), your intended percentage of working time (80% or 100%), your current place of residence, and whether you have the legal right to work in your intended work station.

Junior Product Manager
======================

**REJOIGNEZ NOTRE EQUIPE !**

Fondée en 1892 à Lancaster, en Pennsylvanie, Hamilton crée des montres offrant un équilibre unique entre authenticité et innovation. Les montres Hamilton ont contribué à la synchronisation des premiers chemins de fer et accompagné les pionniers de l'aviation, ainsi que les soldats américains. Grandes favorites des cinéastes depuis des décennies, les montres Hamilton sont apparues dans plus de 500 films, avec des modèles personnalisés ayant joué un rôle clé dans plusieurs blockbusters hollywoodiens.

Membre du Swatch Group, leader mondial dans la fabrication et la distribution de montres, Hamilton conjugue esprit américain et précision suisse dans ses collections actuelles. Authenticité et innovation sont deux valeurs qu'Hamilton cultive, tant à travers ses montres qu'à travers ses collaborateurs. La quête d'excellence et l'esprit d'aventure caractérisent chaque projet que nous entreprenons.

**LE JOB**

Afin de renforcer notre département Product Management, nous recherchons un **Junior Product Manager**.

Rattaché au Head of Product Management, vous participez au développement et au lancement de lignes de produits, depuis les premières réflexions créatives jusqu'à leur mise sur le marché. Au coeur d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, vous collaborez notamment avec le Design, la Qualité, les Achats, le Marketing, les Ventes et les partenaires externes.

**VOS MISSIONS**

* Responsabilité du développement de lignes de produits selon la planification établie par le Head of Product Management :
* Participation à l'élaboration du design produit
* Etablissement de la planification et suivi des délais
* Consultation et suivi des fournisseurs, pilotage de la convergence design\-production\-coûts
* Négociation des prix des composants en collaboration avec les Achats
* Etablissement des calculs de prix
* Pilotage de la fabrication des prototypes
* Etablissement de la documentation technique


* Coordination du lancement du produit en étroite collaboration avec les départements concernés jusqu'à la mise sur le marché :
    + Participation au plan de communication Produit en collaboration avec le Marketing
    + Mise à disposition du Marketing et de la Vente des informations et outils nécessaires pour la promotion des Produits en phase de lancement
    + Présentations internes et externes des nouveautés, participation à des formations Produit dans les filiales
* Suivi dans le temps des lignes de produit :
    + Analyse des ventes en collaboration avec la Vente


* Participation à l'élaboration du Plan Produit  

* Contrôle et coordination des montres pour les départements Marketing et Ventes

* Préparation des présentations produits et des feuilles de route ainsi que des tableaux de produits

* Mise à jour des manuels d'utilisation

* Développement d'emballages spéciaux

* Préparation et diffusion des fiches techniques des produits

* Organisation de formations internes

* Analyse des tendances des marchés

**VOTRE PROFIL**

* CFC d'employé.e de commerce
* Formation supérieure en marketing avec une 1^e expérience réussie dans le développement Produit
* 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans l'horlogerie au sein d'un département développement Produit ou Marketing
* Expérience dans la gestion de projets avec capacités de vue d'ensemble dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire
* Intérêt prononcé pour le marketing produit
* Compréhension des problématiques techniques horlogères
* Sens aigü de la communication
* Esprit d'équipe
* Esprit de leadership et sens de l'initiative
* Forte sensibilité desing et au courant de tendances actuelles
* Esprit analytique et orienté solution
* Force de persuasion et de négociation
* Langue maternelle française avec de très bonnes connaissances de l'anglais
* Maîtrise des produits MS Office
* Connaissances SAP un atout


**VOTRE ETAT D'ESPRIT**

title: Flight Software Systems Engineer for Space Missions
description:
Einleitungstext
Led by Prof. Dr. Thomas Zurbuchen, ETH Zurich | Space brings together space-related research, education and technology development across ETH Zurich. Working with academic, industrial and institutional partners, the initiative develops new space missions, instruments and technologies.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

Projekthintergrund
The objective of this initiative is to establish and grow a centralized pool of space engineering expertise within ETH Zurich | Space. This pool supports ETH Zurich-led space projects and technology programs, strengthening ETH Zurich’s role in the Swiss and international space ecosystem.

The Flight Software Systems Engineer will support a diverse portfolio of small spacecraft, scientific instruments, robotic systems, and technology demonstrators. The work includes resource-constrained missions, integration with externally supplied spacecraft platforms, autonomous functions, and future distributed or coordinated spacecraft concepts. This role interfaces across systems engineering, avionics, payloads, and software development, and coordinates with external platform providers and mission operations teams.

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
As part of the specialized resource pool, you will provide flight software and software systems engineering expertise across multiple ETH Zurich space projects. You will contribute from early mission formulation and software architecture through implementation, integration, verification, launch preparation, and operations.

As part of your role, you will:

Take technical ownership of assigned flight software developments and act as the primary software interface to systems engineering, avionics, payload teams, mission operations, and external platform providers.
Translate mission concept of operations into spacecraft behaviors and define flight software architectures and functional decompositions
Allocate hardware-software functions, and define associated software requirements and interfaces.
Translate mission and system requirements into software specifications, interface control documents, operational concepts, and verification plans.
Develop embedded flight software in C and C++ and supporting tools and test scripts (e.g., Python), including device drivers, telemetry and telecommand handling, onboard data management, application software, and fault-management functions.
Integrate flight software with onboard computers, sensors, actuators, payload electronics, communication interfaces, ground systems, and externally supplied spacecraft platforms.
Set up and maintain flat-sat flight software testbeds
Perform software-related trade studies covering processing capacity, memory, timing, bandwidth, autonomy, reliability, and fault tolerance.
Develop real-time, event-driven, autonomous, synchronization, and GNC-related software functions where required.
Establish and maintain software baselines, configuration control, versioning, build automation, continuous integration, release management, and requirements traceability.
Develop and execute flight software unit tests, conduct integration, software-in-the-loop, processor-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and system-level verification and validation activities.
Support software risk management, anomaly investigation, non-conformance handling, and technical review boards.
Support spacecraft and payload assembly, integration, and test activities, commissioning, in-flight software updates, telemetry analysis, and mission operations.
Contribute to technical reviews, early-stage mission concepts, proposals, and software feasibility studies.
Provide technical guidance to junior engineers, researchers, and student teams.
Ihr Profil
You have a strong background in embedded and real-time software development combined with systems-level experience in software architecture, requirements engineering, interface definition, integration, and functional verification. You are comfortable working across mission, spacecraft, avionics, payload, software, and operations domains.

We are looking for someone with:

Master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, aerospace engineering, robotics, or a related field.
5+ years of professional experience in flight software, embedded software, or mission-critical software systems.
Strong programming skills in C and C++ for resource-constrained embedded targets.
Experience with real-time operating systems, embedded Linux, or bare-metal development.
Experience in software systems engineering, including architecture definition, functional decomposition, hardware-software allocation, requirements management, and interface control.
Ability to translate mission and spacecraft requirements into software specifications, operational concepts, and verification strategies.
Experience integrating flight software with avionics hardware, sensors, actuators, communication buses, payloads, or ground systems.
Understanding of telemetry and telecommand, onboard data handling, timing, autonomy, fault management, and spacecraft operations.
Hands-on experience with software integration, debugging, automated testing, and hardware-in-the-loop environments.
Experience with configuration management, version control, release processes, technical baselines, and requirements traceability.
Ability to assess software-related technical resources, including processing capacity, memory, timing, bandwidth, and reliability margins.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
Knowledge of radiation effects, redundancy, memory protection, watchdogs, and FDIR.

title: DevOps Engineer (a) (80 ? 100%)
description:
**HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.**

**Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.**

**Deine Herausforderung**

* Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.

* Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.

* Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.

* Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.

* Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.

* Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.

* Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.

* Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.

**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)

* Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab

* Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

* Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.

* In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher

title: F1 Data Scientist
description:
The Data Intelligence Team works alongside different technical groups to lead the data transformation of the department. Our work focuses on designing, building and deploying end to end data solutions that will enable more effective real-time decisions trackside and allow data-driven design of future sporting and technical regulations.
We seek result-driven, proactive people, who are passionate about building high-quality software solutions that address problems by transforming how engineers use data and technology. They must have a desire to innovate in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, as part of a growing team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in the unique and inspiring world of Motorsport.
The position will be based in our headquarters in Geneva and will involve some travel to Formula 1 championship events.

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
As F1 Data Scientist your mission is to design, test and deploy data solutions that transform raw motorsport data into powerful, actionable insights. You will work with large and diverse sources of data including telemetry time series, images or regulatory documents across multiple championships with the aim to build innovative tools and models that enhance understanding, and support fast decision-making.
To accomplish this, you will be part of the end-to-end product life-cycle: from requirement gathering and PoC development to deployment of production-ready solutions designed to scale, be understood by end users, meet organisation requirements and adapt as needs evolve.  

This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, owns their work end-to-end, and actively contributes to a high-performing team.

Data Science
Develop Machine Learning models and advanced analytical tools that can provide further insights for decision-making.  
Further develop the FIA data analytics tool suite to optimise our remote and on-track support operations through real time analysis.
Investigate multimodal approaches that integrate telemetry time series, image, video, audio, and regulatory documents to enrich analytical capabilities.

MLOps Solutions
Build and maintain robust MLOps solutions to ensure scalability, reliability and continuous improvement of the deployed solutions.  
Collaborate with the Data Intelligence group to standardize data processing and promote shared tools across different FIA championships.

Latest Technology Watch
Stay up to date with state-of-the-art models, especially on time series treatment and the multi-modality area.  
Stay up to date on MLOps tools, techniques and best practices to enhance team capabilities.

PROFILE:
Master’s degree or equivalent working experience level in Computer Science, Data Science, AI Engineer, ML Ops Engineer or similar discipline.
You have extensive experience developing clean and efficient software in Python.  
You have significant experience with data wrangling libraries such as pandas, numpy, and PySpark.
You have significant experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as Sklearn, SciPy, XGBoost or Pytorch.
You have extensive experience with the ML development lifecycle and MLOps solutions (MLFlow or similar) for model versioning, registry and experiment tracking.
You have knowledge of CI/CD pipeline implementation and containerization (Docker).  
You have experience with SQL and No-SQL databases.
You have demonstrated an ability to learn continuously and work autonomously. You are comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and fast iteration with users.
You have demonstrated your ability to work effectively within teams with mixed technical expertise.
You are native or fluent in English. French is not required but appreciated.  
You are interested in Motorsport and are curious about how the field evolves and how data can impact it.  


The following skills are not required but if you have experience in any of them, we would love to hear more:  

You have experience developing computer vision solutions.
You have experience with open source LLM frameworks or Cloud based managed LLM solutions
You have experience with embedded machine learning
You have experience within the motorsport industry
You have experience working with Cloud Solutions, specifically AWS

If you are interested, please send us your CV and any relevant document.
The FIA is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

title: Terms of Reference Investment Specialist
description:
Terms of Reference
Investment Specialist (80% or full-time)

Catalytic’s mission is to accelerate the design and deployment of catalytic finance solutions for sustainable infrastructure and nature. We identify and develop robust project pipelines and deploy technical assistance to support projects to become more investible and impactful. Catalytic seeks to ensure positive social and environmental outcomes in addition to financial returns for impact investors, applying credible methodologies for the measurement and evaluation of impacts. In addition, Catalytic incubates and structures blended-finance funds aiming at scaling up and speeding up the implementation of infrastructure projects with positive climate impacts.

Catalytic is seeking an Investment Specialist.
Catalytic has also been mandated through Canopy Trust by multiple donors to support and scale up private sector, development-focused investments to reduce deforestation in Central Africa, covering DRC, Republic of the Congo, Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Gabon. To this end, Canopy Trust identifies and builds a robust pipeline of investment funds and local, private sector projects and companies which will lead to  economic development, reduction of deforestation, and conservation of forest in the region. Canopy Trust offers technical assistance and invests catalytic, concessional capital to direct investment, it also investor de-risking junior capital into suitable investment funds that commit to capital allocation to Canopy Trust’s target countries.. The Investment Specialist will primarily work on the investment activities for Canopy Trust.

Reporting to the Deputy CEO and working closely with other team members and Catalytic’s partners, the Investment Specialist will support Catalytic in deploying its concessional capital. This will include originating investment opportunities, conducting evaluation, assessment and due diligence of investment opportunities (investment funds, corporates/SMEs and projects), as well as the negotiation of term sheets, preparation of documentations for the Investment Committees, and finalisation of investment documentations until financial close. The Investment Specialist will also be responsible for managing Canopy Trust’s portfolio of investments, including advising, supporting, and monitoring the investees in the portfolio as well as reporting.

Role & Responsibilities:
Independently lead identification sourcing and management high-quality transaction pipeline in line with Canopy Trust’s mandate, target sectors and geographies through direct outreach and relevant channels in the target region, manage selection workflow and maintain pipeline tracker
Maintain close proximity and awareness with the Canopy Trust Technical Assistance pipeline to be able to assess which of these TA projects to prioritize for investment pipeline and to anticipate the associated timeline
Independently lead investment processes, including screening of investment opportunities and preparing documentation for internal decision-making and prioritization
Independently lead and coordinate due diligence (financial, operational, legal, integrity and ESG), (credit) risk analysis, term sheet negotiation (structuring features, conditions precedent, covenants, reporting and monitoring requirements)
Lead preparation of high-quality investment memorandums and recommendations for submission to the IC, and investment documentation.
Advise, support, and monitor the investees
Manage Canopy Trust’s investment portfolio including post investment activities and analysis
Provide numbers, results, and deliverables for Communication, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Reporting.
Support in other investment-related activities of Catalytic when required.

Profile:
Minimum 5 years of experience in investment analysis, due diligence, negotiation of term sheets and contracts, structuring and closing transactions, overseeing investees, and portfolio management, preferably at an asset manager, investment bank or financial advisor.
Experience in working in an investment role in Africa and/or other frontier and emerging markets and fragile country contexts, preferably in Canopy Trust’s focus markets
Working experience in direct private debt investments and structuring; experience in restructuring and workouts preferred.
Experience in Canopy Trust’s focus sectors and a good understanding of business development and financial models of infrastructure projects, experience in deforestation-free value chain investment
Experience working in the space of impact, blended-finance investment for climate targets would be a plus.
Experience in managing or investing in and/or managing investment funds, including understanding of blended finance structures and risk mitigation instruments, concessionality and GP diligence would be a plus.
Experience with international standards, such as IFC Performance Standards, Gold Standard, would be a plus.
Passionate about reducing deforestation and climate mitigation with a strong commitment towards a more sustainable world.
Team player, flexible and experienced in working in a multicultural environment.
Taking initiatives and thinking out of the box to find solutions to challenges are needed on a daily basis.
Proficient English and French level in writing and speaking, additional language skills a plus.
Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in business, finance or economics.

The working station will be Geneva, Switzerland, or Kinshasa, DRC, with travels depending on project needs.

The position is possible to start at 80%. However, as the investment portfolio enlarges, it is expected that 100% would be needed at some point in the future.

Please send your CV and a Cover Letter to secretariat@catalyticfinance.org by 31 October 2026. Please indicate clearly on your Cover Letter your intended working station (Geneva or Kinshasa), your intended percentage of working time (80% or 100%), your current place of residence, and whether you have the legal right to work in your intended work station.

CBRE Global Workplace Solutions provides integrated facility management services on all continents with more than 60,000 employees. In Switzerland, the GWS division provides technical, infrastructural and commercial facility management services for clients from various industries.  
  
For our growing Facility Management organization at a client in Zug we are looking for a:  
  
Facility Supervisor  
  
Your main tasks:  
  


* Delivery of 'best in class' customer services and satisfaction, including, but not limited to cleaning, pest control, mail services, light duty maintenance, food services, reception, security, managing the relationship with T2 suppliers at a high level, to ensure specifications, SOWs and SLAs are followed, respected and achieved.

* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross\-train staff.

* Point of contact for escalated communications between landlord, employees and service providers by ensuring all procedures, policies, and reporting formats are understood, and implemented.

* Periodically inspects common area equipment to ensure good operating condition.

* Arrange for regular maintenance of equipment.

* Design and oversee the schedule for cleaning and disinfecting the building.

* Review data from work order reports and create and present performance and progress status reports to management. Make suggestions on how to improve efficiency.

* Conduct market research and compare costs and benefits when evaluating new vendors.

* Keep track of regular and ad\-hoc facility expenses.

* Accountable for a flawless budget management, by direct involvement on contract negotiation, contributing to forecasting, annual budget preparation, cost savings and variance/deviation analysis.

* Oversee and evaluate T2 suppliers' performance by participating on monthly/quarterly meetings, analyzing gaps/overlaps, and providing feedback to reinforce their engagement.

* Resolve complex problems and identify appropriate approaches to existing solutions to accomplish team objectives.

* establish new techniques to ensure the team is able to meet its objectives.

* Follows security and emergency procedures as defined for the property.

* Has a direct impact on the team objectives as well as the objectives of related teams.

* Bachelor's degree (BA/BSc) or Facility Management professional certification.

* Customer Service experience required. A minimum of three year of related progressive experience.

* Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from clients, co\-workers and/or supervisor.

* Warm and engaging demeanour. Ability to assess circumstances, empathise and offer help.

* Utilise a high level of attention to detail as well as strong interpersonal skills.

* Fluent and English

* Open and innovative working environment with design options

title: Critical Infrastructure Mechanical Engineer, Field Engineering
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Field Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.
* Possess excellent communication and writing skills, attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.
* Organized and have the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines and budget
* Have experience solving problems with engineered solutions.
* Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Controls, Construction, Design, Commissioning, Product Managers, Technical Program Managers, ).
* Are adaptable and inclined to get into the field to see things up close.
* Excited about a mix of office and field work.

**Key job responsibilities
**

You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

* Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
* Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
* Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, increase efficiency and sustainability.
* Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

**About the team
**

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.


**Diverse Experiences
**

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


**Work/Life Balance
**

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


**Inclusive Team Culture
**

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.


**Mentorship and Career Growth
**

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic qualifications
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken English
* Willing to travel between Data Center sites, and internationally if required
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering or equivalent
* Experience with mission critical facilities engineering including but not limited to the following sectors: data centers, power generation, oil & gas facilities. (Experienced Engineer).
Preferred qualifications
* Possess data analytics skills, data querying skills/language, scripting, and comfort with working in vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments
* Direct experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers.
* Experience as resident engineer or hands-on (in the field) design consultant or owner’s engineer.
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region. Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents.
* Ability to carry design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment/mass production.
* Basic understanding of both mechanical and/or electrical equipment/design related to data centers (Including but not limited to: uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switch gear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, fans, air economizers, water treatment, etc...).
* EPMS/SCADA/BMS Controls system experience (software and/or hardware)
* Business-level fluency in written and spoken German and English
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Gas Turbine Plant Operator
==========================

**Your primary responsibility is to monitor and control the gas turbine power plant systems from the control room, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation. **Your tasks**

* Monitor and operate power plant equipment and systems using the Emerson Ovation control system;
* Perform plant start\-up, shutdown, and load adjustment procedures;
* Identify, analyze, and respond to alarms, faults, and operational disturbances;
* Perform and document switching operations in accordance with safety procedures;
* Support emergency response activities during abnormal operating conditions;
* Coordinate activities with Maintenance, Engineering, and external service providers;
* Maintain shift logs, operational records, and incident reports;
* Conduct plant inspections and verify equipment conditions in the field;
* Support maintenance activities, outages, overhauls, and recommissioning;
* Ensure effective shift handovers and compliance with plant procedures and safety regulations.




**Your profile**

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification;
* Strong technical understanding of power generation or industrial process systems;
* Several years of experience in the operation of power plants, industrial plants, or process facilities is preferred, experience in the power generation industry is considered a strong advantage;
* Minimum one year of experience in commissioning activities;
* Ability to remain calm and take decisions under pressure;
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills;
* Critical thinking, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities;
* Well\-organized with the ability to plan, prioritize, and coordinate activities efficiently;
* Open\-minded team player with a proactive attitude;
* Willingness to travel internationally for up to 30% of working time;
* Excellent command of English; German is considered an advantage.




**Your benefit with us**

* A collaborative and highly motivated international team environment;
* Contribute to a reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure;
* Interesting and challenging tasks with a high level of responsibility;
* Exposure to advanced gas turbine and power generation technologies;
* Opportunities for professional growth and development;
* Enjoy a modern workplace in Birr (AG), Switzerland, conveniently located between Zurich and Basel**.**

title: GxP Compliance Expert
description:
GxP Compliance Expert  


  











GxP Compliance Expert
=====================




  








 **GxP Compliance Expert \- GxP / Compliance / Clinical Distribution Team / Managing deviations/CAPAs/improvements / GxP training / Root Cause Analysis (RCA / Englisch**



  **Background:**



A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what makes us Roche.



The Clinical Distribution organisation's objective is to cost\-effectively ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time every time, such that no patient will go without treatment and no clinical trial will be delayed.



The GxP Compliance Expert is a member of the Network \& Capabilities Chapter within the Clinical Distribution Team (Deliver), which is jointly accountable for all elements of clinical supply chain distribution for the global Roche/Genentech portfolio of \>500 studies. This role drives GxP compliance and quality within Clinical Distribution (Deliver). Key duties include proactive GxP advice, managing deviations/CAPAs/improvements, acting as the audit/inspection SME, handling regulated documents, analysing quality trends, and developing the team's GxP training.



  



  **The Perfect Candidate:**



For this position, we are seeking an experienced professional with a relevant university degree and several years of solid working experience in GxP compliance and the clinical supply chain. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in regulatory requirements and quality standards, along with experience in audit and inspection processes. Structured and customer\-oriented working methods, strong communication skills, and fluency in both German and English are required



  



 **Tasks \& Responsibilities:**



* SME for all GxP and compliance\-related topics (proactive advice on these matters) incl system administration (Veeva quality docs)
* Audit/Inspection SME for Deliver for non\-study specific examinations
* Processing of deviations as well as CAPAs, Changes, Process Improvements
* Quality KPI Ownership for Deliver
* Responsibility for deviation management improvement processes
* Offer comprehensive compliance expertise to the business, conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to identify and address quality, regulatory and compliance\-related issues
* Managing the structure for the departments' SOPs and any other regulated documents (The business know\-how is provided by the chapter's SMEs)
* Responsibility for trend reporting across Quality and Compliance requirements
* Implementation of GxP training and further development of employees' GxP knowledge


  



 **Must Haves:**



* You hold a degree (BA, MS, MBA) in a relevant field (e.g. Supply Chain Management \& Logistics, Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Industrial Engineering and Management), backed by significant expertise and extensive years of senior professional experience.
* At least 6 years of professional experience
* You possess extensive knowledge of cGMP standards alongside hands\-on experience navigating internal (PTQ, Pharma\-Technical Quality) and external (e.g., FDA, EMA) regulatory inspections.
* You bring a deep understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain management, specifically encompassing warehouse and transportation management, logistics, and clinical supply chain distribution processes.
* You demonstrate strong interpersonal, communication, organisational, and prioritisation skills with a steadfast focus on customer needs.
* You are fluent in both written and spoken German and English.
* You are proficient in using Google applications, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Visio, and key industry systems such as Veeva and Cornerstone**.**

title: Strategic Pricing Analyst
description:
About Surgery

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of surgery? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Surgery team will give you the chance to deliver surgical technologies and solutions to surgeons and healthcare professionals around the world. Your contributions will help effectively treat some of the world’s most prevalent conditions such as obesity, cardiovascular disease and cancer. Patients are waiting.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

Strategic Pricing Analyst Surgery - Johnson & Johnson
Are you passionate about making a tangible difference in healthcare?
We are seeking a Strategic Pricing Analyst to join our commercial team.
This role anchors Johnson & Johnson’s go-to-market strategy, emphasizing long-term partnerships, market trends and customer needs.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to advance pricing strategies and new business models, evaluate pricing proposals, and provide guidance on organizational standards related to product performance.
If you’re a strategic thinker with a proven track record in price and margin calculations, you are the candidate we want to hear from.

Roles & responsibilities

Strategic Pricing is an essential part of the future business strategy for the Johnson & Johnson companies. It influences how we will go to market as a Surgery organization and will be critical to our future growth plans. This approach aligns customer expectations with business objectives with the aim to demonstrate the long-term value of partnership and working with Johnson & Johnson, most importantly, our impact on patient care.

· In the role as Strategic Pricing Analyst you will report to the Commercial Lead of the Swiss Surgery organization and closely collaborate with the Strategic Account Management, the Operational Pricing, the Sales Organization and the Marketing Team.
· Together with the Strategic Account Management and our clinical team, you will coordinate and support the proposal development process, presenting opportunities and risks along with their implications to the required levels of management.
· You will develop data driven pricing-strategies to maximize profitability and competitiveness
· In close collaboration with our Marketing Team you prepare new product launches, go to market models and potential portolio segmentations.
· In conjunction with the Surgery Leadership Team, you will coordinate regular reviews of departmental pricing analysis reports and submit results on a timely basis to the Management for review and subsequents directives.
· Together with the Operational Pricing Team you will analyse current pricing models and structures to identify areas to improve pricing efficiencies for the customer base.

You will define local price-volume guidance and lead the design and testing of new tools to support the local sales force.
To support business plan development and account stretegies you will provide recommendations on alternate pricing models to the Management in order to secure key customer business.

· You will assess and track pricing key performance measures as well as ad hoc analysis and reporting to measure against pricing goals and targets.
· You are the direct link to the EMEA Pricing Team
· Working at Johnson & Johnson implifies understanding and applying of Johnson & Johnson’s Credo and Leadership Imperatives in day-to-day interactions with the team.



Qualifications

Academic or financial background, ideally supported by a Master’s degree in Business Administration with several years of experience in pricing or a comparable role.
Strong understanding of profit and loss statements (P&L), margin analysis, cost structures, and price-demand relationships.
Experience in contracting and deal structuring is a plus.
Analytical and strategic thinker with solid business acumen.
Project management capabilities with the ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset.
Excellent written and verbal communication in German, strong English skills (written and spoken) are required; proficiency in a second official language is preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, along with experience using Power BI and other financial analysis tools; programming skills are an asset, ERP (S4/H) knowledge is a plus.
